name: Devin
verdict: Pro is $20 a month, but the quota is opaque and Teams has an $80 minimum before you add seats.
pros: Desktop, CLI, and cloud agents on one plan
Flex seats on Teams are free
Extra usage is API pricing, not a mystery credit
cons: Included quota is not a published message count
Teams costs $80 even with no full seats
pricingNote: Docs at docs.devin.ai match these prices. Flex seats are $0 and draw from shared on-demand credits. SWE-2 is free in Devin Desktop and the CLI through October 16, 2026.
